Samir — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and a proposed next step: 

Summary of what we heard
- Pain: inconsistent search relevance across categories leading to degraded conversion on promotions.
- Current stack: in-house retrieval + 3rd-party ranking; limited ability to iterate on prompts/weights quickly.
- Success metric: +6–10% CVR uplift for promotional queries; reduce manual tuning cycles.

What Redwood can deliver (short)
- Low-latency ranked responses (<=120ms p95 on standard queries) with controlled cost profiles.
- Prefix caching and batching to keep costs predictable for promo traffic spikes.
- Short pilot: measurement on a merchant segment (2–4 weeks) — we bring a test harness, you validate lift.

Proposed next step
- 30-minute technical sync with your infra/ML lead to validate integration surface and pilot scope.
- I attached a 1-page recap and a suggested pilot timeline.

Attachment: redwood-discovery-recap.pdf (1-page summary + pilot bump options)

If this fits, I can send three times for the tech sync — or if you prefer, point me to the right person.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
